parameters.name: KeyPairName
parameters.description: The name of the key pair. The name must be unique. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and must start with a letter, either uppercase or lowercase, or a Chinese character. It cannot start with http:// or https://. The name can contain characters that are classified as letters in Unicode, including letters, Chinese characters, and digits. It can also contain colons (:), underscores (_), periods (.), or hyphens (-).

parameters.name: PublicKeyBody
parameters.description: The public key of the key pair.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the enterprise resource group to which the SSH key pair belongs.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The tag key of the key pair. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with aliyun or acs:. It cannot contain http:// or https://.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The tag value of the key pair. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag value can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot contain http:// or https://.
